note: npm_latest, licence and npm_modified come from registry.npmjs.org on the verified date; refresh with pick.py --refresh. Layers follow the video: foundation, specialist, design; plus motion-data and plumbing from Emil Kowalski's list.

libraries.name: shadcn/ui
libraries.why: Copy-in components with Radix or Base UI behaviour under them; code lives in your repo so the agent can restyle it.
libraries.source: Griffin Wooldridge video zsCGS-Yzjnw, 7 Nov 2026; Champ project use or our own addition
libraries.avoid: Do not ship the default look: radius, gray and font are the AI calling card. Change those three from the brand skill first.
flags: Default radius, gray and font read as AI-made. Retheme from DESIGN.md before the polish pass

Tested 11 Nov in a fresh Vite 8 + Tailwind 4 app: shadcn add button wrote from "cn" and npm-installed a junk package named cn. Fix: src/lib/utils.ts (clsx + tailwind-merge), rewrite the import to @/lib/utils, npm rm cn

libraries.name: Base UI
libraries.why: Unstyled accessible primitives: dialogs, popovers, menus, selects with focus and dismissal handled.
libraries.source: Emil Kowalski pick-ui-library (MIT); Griffin Wooldridge video zsCGS-Yzjnw, 7 Nov 2026
libraries.avoid: Not when shadcn already ships the styled component you need.
flags: Package renamed: older @base-ui-components/react is the pre-1.0 line; use @base-ui/react

libraries.name: Radix UI
libraries.why: The primitives under most shadcn installs today. Fine to keep; new work should start from the shadcn or Base UI route.
libraries.avoid: Do not add alongside Base UI in the same component set.
flags: Listed as a foundation in the video; Emil's list prefers Base UI for new primitives

libraries.name: react-day-picker

libraries.source: Champ project use or our own addition

libraries.name: Beautiful UI (Turbo)
libraries.why: Primitives built for AI products: streaming text, approval cards, diffs, thinking and tool states. 27 registry items on 11 Nov.
flags: Install-tested 11 Nov: stream-text and approval-card install, but the registry's foundation.css has one extra closing brace (a lost @media opener around .records-footer-hint) and the Tailwind build fails until it is repaired by hand. Also needs the shadow-plugin npm package (MIT) and ignores the @/ alias layout (writes src/app/beautifui and src/components/atoms, primitives); one component needs a type-only import under verbatimModuleSyntax
Licence text not read; a MIT repo TurboKach/ai-native-react-components exists but I did not confirm it is the same project. Check before any client build
Verdict: pilot only, on an AI-product screen, with the CSS brace repaired and the media query restored

libraries.name: RareUI
libraries.why: Showpiece moments: animated buttons, text effects, interactive backgrounds. CLI: npx rareui add <component>.
flags: Site says free for commercial use; a MIT repo Codewithswappy/RareUI exists but I did not confirm it is the same project. Not install-tested

libraries.name: Magic UI
libraries.why: 260 free animated components on top of shadcn (registry count 11 Nov). Landing-page set pieces.
libraries.avoid: One accent per page, not ten.
flags: MIT on GitHub (magicuidesign/magicui)
Install-tested 11 Nov: marquee via the shadcn CLI landed clean, wrote its keyframes into index.css, typechecked and built

libraries.name: Aceternity UI
libraries.why: Landing-page effects: 3D maps, beams, moving lines. Install through the shadcn CLI or the agent.
flags: Install-tested 11 Nov: background-beams via the shadcn CLI landed and built; it pulls motion and needs @/lib/utils. Its file left an unused variable that fails strict noUnusedLocals
Free-tier licence not checked; some components are paid Pro

libraries.name: 21st.dev marketplace
libraries.why: Marketplace of 12,000+ components from many authors; the place for something specific that no single library covers. Key TWENTY_FIRST_API_KEY; install via registry.21st.dev.
libraries.source: Griffin Wooldridge video zsCGS-Yzjnw, 7 Nov 2026; Champ project use or our own addition
